goal: maximize net portfolio profit within the declared risk and execution constraints

period.ledger: one continuous portfolio; no reset at year or holdout boundary

information_cutoff.decision: once per trading day before opening
information_cutoff.membership: previous completed trading-day KIND ST membership; never current master
information_cutoff.filings: receipt date strictly earlier than decision date; available_on <= decision date
information_cutoff.corrections: latest disclosed receipt of latest financial period as of decision date
information_cutoff.news: not used in this deterministic first strategy

universe.source_group: KIND ST/detailType=1 domestic company representative codes
universe.unresolved_code_identity_or_corporate_ac: block affected signal/execution and mark backtest coverage incomplete; never silently drop a held position

financial_filter.scope: December fiscal year; explicit consolidated standard Revenue and OperatingIncomeLoss; KRW
financial_filter.q1_q2_q3: single receipt current 3 months versus same 3 months one year earlier
financial_filter.annual: single receipt full year versus previous full year; not synthetic Q4
financial_filter.pass: current revenue > prior comparable revenue AND current operating income > max(0, prior comparable operating income)
financial_filter.missing_latest: block new purchases; never revive an older positive report; not a sell signal alone

entry.history: at least 60 valid prior trading-day closes; do not fill missing bars with current prices
entry.trend: stock last close > stock SMA60 AND KOSPI last close > KOSPI SMA60
entry.chasing_guard: stock 5-trading-day return <= 15% AND stock last close <= stock SMA20 * 1.10
entry.rank: descending stock-minus-KOSPI 20-trading-day return; tie ascending code
entry.allocation: descending rank; integer shares; each order capped at 20% prior-close NAV and remaining pre-sale cash including costs; no leverage or top-ups
entry.fully_invested: do not replace held stocks just because a higher-ranked stock appears

hold_and_exit.hold: keep share count unchanged while no exit condition; no fixed-day or ranking rotation
hold_and_exit.trend_exit: two consecutive valid trading-day closes below each day's stock SMA60
hold_and_exit.earnings_exit: newly available latest comparable financial report fails financial_filter.pass
hold_and_exit.missing_data: not assumed deterioration; record uncertainty and block uncertifiable execution

execution.fill: next market open after prior-information decision; not production limit-order replay
execution.same_batch_sale_proceeds: unavailable for buys until following trading day
execution.tradeability: positive volume and valid positive open; missing/suspended bars cannot fill
execution.unfilled: no implicit future fill; re-evaluate next trading day
execution.costs_are: research assumptions, not an actual dated broker/tax schedule
execution.corporate_actions: raw prices for execution; verify splits, rights, dividends, merger and delisting proceeds/quantities and causal signal adjustments before certifying results

evaluation.primary: ending net NAV minus initial NAV in KRW and total net return
evaluation.turnover_definition: sum absolute executed trade value / initial NAV
comparisons: stable baseline under declared comparable input/execution conditions
initial eligible basket held without discretionary rotation
KOSPI price index reference, not ETF purchases
evaluation.acceptance: no performance claim until full data coverage, action handling, tests and continuous backtest; no holdout tuning
